rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction, same Validate/CaddyModule/UnmarshalCaddyfile shape, registered beside cookie, interface assertions added in all three var blocks.
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable lines pass through, exact name match, quoting preserved, delete drops the element, suffix kept verbatim; whitespace-only values would duplicate padding (minor) and defensive name re-check silently no-ops.
rationale.scope: Only the requested filter plus registration; the leading/trailing whitespace preservation and extra unicode import go slightly beyond the ask but stay on-topic.
rationale.readability: Clear names and structure; the whitespace bookkeeping in replaceSetCookieValue is more involved than needed and a couple of comments over-explain (e.g. citing the empty-hash prefix).
rationale.robustness: All slice indices are bounds-checked, no panics on malformed input, non-array fields returned untouched; stateless so no concurrency concerns.
rationale.maintainability: Reuses hash() and cookieFilterAction; Caddyfile unmarshalling is duplicated verbatim from CookieFilter, which matches existing pattern but adds a second copy to keep in sync.
